messages:
Ana: starting PRD intake thread for "Tenant Safeguard Playbook" — building a lightweight feature to let product teams run staged model upgrades per-tenant with simple quality gates. problem stmt: customers want less friction and fewer regressions when we move them to new model versions. current flow too manual (SRE runbooks + ad-hoc canaries).

Ana: high-level goals:
- let product teams start a progressive rollout targeting tenant cohorts (percent -> cohort list -> 100%).
- wire in 3 guardrail checks (latency, quality-eval, error-rate) with thresholded automation.
- expose a one-click rollback / pause and an audit log for compliance.

Theo: non-goals to call out so scope stays small:
- not replacing infra deployment system (no scheduler work).
- no bespoke billing changes or per-tenant pricing in alpha.
- no advanced anomaly-detection ML for alpha — simple thresholds + short window baselines.

Jamal: suggested success metrics (alpha):
- can perform a rollback within 6 minutes of trigger 90% of time
- mean time to detect a regression <= 10 min (using hourly evals + streaming errors)
- false-positive rollback rate < 5% on our internal test tenants
- product teams can start a rollout in < 3 clicks / via CLI command

Priya: acceptance criteria checklist draft:
1) UX: UI + CLI both allow: select model version, pick cohort (by tag or upload CSV), choose percentages (1,5,10,25,50,100).
2) Guardrails: configure thresholds: latency_pct_increase, eval_fail_delta, client_error_rate_increase.
3) Automation: on threshold breach -> auto-pause rollout, create incident, send tenant owner + infra oncall notification.
4) Rollback: manual rollback button + automated rollback if configured.
5) Observability: per-tenant time series + exportable audit record (who started rollout, timestamps, actions).

Ana: short example policy defaults to show in docs:
```
defaults:
  latency_pct_increase: 12
  eval_fail_delta: 3
  client_error_rate_increase: 5
  evaluation_window_minutes: 60
```

Theo: ops question — where do tenant-specific eval sets live? we need secure storage for customer-uploaded evals if we support that. maybe a later opt-in.

Jamal: edge cases to capture now:
- tenant traffic too low to get signals at small percents -> need minimum sample size before gating.
- tenants with custom prompt transforms -> eval set mismatch; add option for tenant to upload sample traffic + private eval set later.
- multi-model rollouts (model A -> quantized A') where latency improves but subtle quality hits occur. require a manual review checkbox for quantized variants.

Priya: good point on sample size. add acceptance test: if sample_size < N in window, system should mark metric as inconclusive and not auto-rollback (but still surface the warning).

product-ops-bot: Reminder: we need alpha oncall volunteers. Please reply with +1 if you can cover triage windows.

Theo: +1 for alpha triage (evenings UTC).

Jamal: +1 for initial week, can help with incident playbook creation.

Ana: design notes: keep rollout state machine simple — states: PLANNED -> ROLLING -> PAUSED -> ROLLED_BACK -> COMPLETED. expose event stream for audit. docs should include sequence diagram and sample CSV format for cohorts.

Priya: small UX request: allow a dry-run mode that simulates metrics for the first rollout step so product teams can preview likely outcomes. this helps set expectations.

Theo: perf budget ask: alpha must keep p95 latency within 18% of baseline for any tenant or the rollout fails acceptance. add to acceptance checklist.

Jamal: testing plan items:
- internal canary run using 5 synthetic tenants across traffic volumes; inject faults to validate pause + rollback paths.
- customer fixture: import 3 anonymized tenant workloads to validate sample-size logic.

Ana: next steps / owners:
- Ana: draft PRD (problem, goals, non-goals, metrics, acceptance, open questions).
- Priya: write acceptance test scenarios + dry-run UX mock.
- Theo: infra feasibility + secure eval storage options.
- Jamal: incident/runbook + sample data fixtures.

Ana: propose 30m sync tomorrow 10:30am PT to review PRD first draft. everyone ok?

Priya: +1. I'll bring acceptance checklist examples.

Theo: +1. will have infra notes.

Jamal: +1. I'll bring playbook skeleton.

Ana: cool — leaving thread open for quick edits. tagging docs folks later for how-to content. :spiral_note_pad:
